name: proc
description: Background process manager. start spawns a detached process with stdout/stderr captured to a per-proc registry; read polls output; write feeds stdin via FIFO; kill terminates the process group. Linux/Unix only.
use_when: running a long-lived background process (server, watcher, build)

args.name: start <cmd>
args.description: Spawn detached; --cwd sets working dir. Returns proc id.

args.name: read <id>
args.description: Poll output. --tail N or --since <byte-offset> for incremental stdout.

args.name: write <id>
args.description: Append --text (or stdin) to the process's stdin.

args.name: kill <id>
args.description: SIGTERM the process group, SIGKILL after 5s.

stdout: JSON: start -> {id, pid, dir}; read -> {status, stdout, stderr, exit?}; list -> array; write/kill -> ack.

exit_codes.1: operational error (e.g. write to dead proc)
